annotations.title: Approve, deny or change a time-off request

description: Change a time-off request: set its status (0 pending, 1 canceled, 2 accepted/approved, 3 expired, 4 denied) and/or its dates or hours. Reversible — set the status back. start_time and end_time must be given together. When I Work: PUT /2/requests/{request_id}.

end_time.description: New end, full date-time (give with start_time).

hours.description: Hours of paid time off to use.

start_time.description: New start, full date-time (give with end_time).
